name: add Minecraft eaglercraft but a good version and latest
detail: EaglercraftX 1.8.8u53 is the selected build. Survival, keyboard movement, saving and reopening were verified. iPad emulation reached Survival and showed its touch D-pad; a touch press changed the scene, while the integer XYZ readout stayed constant, so touch displacement is not conclusively verified.

quality.evidence: Visible Edge playtest: EaglercraftX 1.8.8u53 loaded Survival; keyboard movement changed position, and Save and Quit followed by reopen restored the same world and position. iPad landscape emulation created a Survival world and showed the D-pad; a forward touch changed the view while the integer XYZ remained x=-98,y=68,z=256, so touch displacement is inconclusive. See eagler18-interaction.png, eagler-touch-survival-before.png and eagler-touch-survival-after.png. The full checker measured 7993 ms cold landscape, 9078 ms portrait and 9318 ms warm landscape, with no page errors.
quality.startupReason: This is an 18 MB self-contained Minecraft JavaScript build with a compiled 3D runtime, world generation and local save data; first session startup includes its sound and profile setup.

selection.reason: 1.8.8u53 is the only compared build in which a complete Survival session, keyboard movement, saved-world reopen and iPad-sized world entry were observed. The 1.12.2u3 WASM build reached its boot and sound setup screens but not a world during this comparison, so its newer version number alone does not outweigh the directly playable 1.8 build.

candidates.evidence: Loaded a full Survival world; keyboard movement and save/reopen were verified. Mobile emulation reached Survival with the D-pad visible; touch forward changed the scene, though the integer coordinate readout stayed constant.

Loaded the offline WASM package in Edge and observed its Mojang boot/sound prompt. No world or gameplay controls were reached in the bounded comparison, so gameplay completeness and control behavior were not verified.
